summary: Portland-born right-wing writer Andy Ngo built a media career from 2017 to 2019 by spreading stripped-of-context clips that cast Muslims and anti-fascist protesters as dangerous, fuelling harassment and doxxing of activists.

evidence.note: born in Portland in 1986 to Vietnamese refugee parents; childhood and schooling covered briefly
2017 interfaith panel clip at Portland State, first viral story and firing from the student paper
several minutes on his 2018 Wall Street Journal piece about Muslims in London and its debunking
edited protest footage amplified on Tucker Carlson framing Portland anti-fascists as a violent threat
Quillette segment on the Lenihan list of journalists and resulting neo-Nazi threats
May Day 2019 Patriot Prayer attack on Cider Riot with Ngo present and filming
fundraising of roughly a quarter million dollars after his July assault, injury claims questioned
coda: he has left Quillette around release, still active

notes: Full biography of a living subject, so the lifetime rule applies (1986 to release year 2019). His 2019 assault is covered but not given a content warning: it is described without graphic detail. Roles mix journalist-propagandist with activist-organizer since the host frames him as a right-wing participant rather than a reporter.
